a: RAG: ingest → chunk → embed → store → retrieve → prompt → generate.
Chunk size balances context quality vs retrieval precision; overlap helps continuity.
Prompt injection tricks models via hostile user content; sanitize and isolate tools.
Tool calling lets models request functions; validate all arguments server-side.
Build offline eval sets to measure accuracy, latency, and regressions.
Guardrails filter unsafe inputs/outputs and enforce policy.
Route simple queries to fast cheap models and hard ones to stronger models.
Cache identical prompts and embeddings to cut cost and latency.
